name: Carnival Corp Ltd.
moat_justification: World's largest cruise operator (nine brands incl. Carnival, Princess, Holland America, Cunard, AIDA, Costa) with scale purchasing, private destinations (Celebration Key, Half Moon Cay), fuel-consumption per ALBD down 26% since 2019 and a record forward book (2027 ~50% booked at record occupancy/pricing, $7.6B deposits) — but low guest switching costs, three scaled rivals (Royal Caribbean, Norwegian, MSC) selling a near-substitute product, no network effects, ~$3.6B/yr capital intensity, and demand that is discretionary and shock-exposed (pandemic, unhedged fuel, geopolitics); pricing only regained 2019 levels in 2024-25 after five lost years.
one_liner: Largest cruise operator, weak-moderate moat 4/10, genuinely repaired operations (record yields, debt <$24B, buybacks back) — but at $26.70 it does not clear the 15% hurdle on current TTM owner's earnings of $2.25/share: weighted IRR 12.2% (Tier C), weighted IV@15% $20.45; it clears 15% only below ~$20.45, or ~$16-17 with a margin of safety against its leverage and shock tail.
